packages.title: Robotics Team Mentorship Program
packages.description: NSF provides structured, student-centered mentorship to developing robotics teams. Our mentorship program helps students strengthen their engineering, programming, testing, documentation, and teamwork skills while maintaining responsibility for their own competition work.
packages.note: These documents are available for reference and planning. Board approval and an operative effective date have not been verified. Completed forms should be sent privately to NSF and must not be posted publicly.

documents.title: Mentorship Program Policy & Overview
documents.description: Program objectives, eligibility, responsibilities, and mentorship principles.

documents.title: Team Mentorship Intake Form
documents.description: Blank application for robotics teams seeking mentorship.

documents.title: Initial Mentorship Plan Template
documents.description: Learning goals, meeting arrangements, responsibilities, and review schedules.
